Title: Azure SQL Database serverless is now generally available

Body.Content:
Azure SQL Database serverless is a new compute tier that optimizes price-performance and simplifies performance management for databases with intermittent, unpredictable usage. Serverless automatically scales compute for single databases based on workload demand and bills for compute used per second. Serverless databases automatically pause during inactive periods when only storage is billed and automatically resume when activity returns. Serverless helps users focus on building apps faster and more efficiently. As with all databases in SQL Database, serverless databases are always up-to-date, highly available, and benefit from built-in intelligence for further security and performance optimization.

Learn more about Azure SQL Database serverless
